''See also: [[Court of Seven (Cradle) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Court]] of Seven is the governing body of the [[Abidan]], consisting of powerful [[Judges]] who oversee vast numbers of worlds. The organization's origins are tied to the world of [[Cradle]], which served as the birthplace for the first generation of the [[Court]]. The [[Judges]] typically operate independently within their specific areas of expertise, though certain members, such as [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]], serve to facilitate cooperation among them. The [[Court]] utilizes various specialized agents and programs, including the [[Executors]] and the [[Reaper Division]], to manage threats and preserve existence. While the [[Judges]] hold immense power, they are capable of issuing unified rulings and sentences, such as death. The group has faced internal challenges, including the loss of members like Ozriel and the betrayal of individuals like the [[Reaper]]. Despite these difficulties, the [[Court]] remains a central force in maintaining order across [[Way|the Way]].}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Before their ascension from [[Cradle]], the first-generation members of the [[Court]] of Seven constructed an ancient [[labyrinth]]. This authoritative group is known for misplacing Ozriel and taking [[Ozmanthus Arelius|Ozmanthus]] into custody. To expand their holdings, they utilized Ozriel as a machete to beat back the wilderness of chaos. Although they manifested together for the first time in centuries, they ultimately denied Ozriel's request to recruit, even as [[Makiel]] might seek to disband them.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The [[Court]] of Seven used Ozriel as a machete to beat back the wilderness of chaos and expand their holdings.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c13">''Reaper'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The first-generation [[Court]] of Seven ascended from [[Cradle]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c15">''Reaper'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Court]] of Seven closely scrutinizes the actions taken by Ozriel, though they have chosen not to execute him. While [[Gadrael]] serves as the second member of this group, the [[Court]] has simultaneously placed restrictions on [[Eithan]]'s abilities. During these events, the [[Abidan]] struck a blow in their name, and the [[Reaper Division]] sought to gain legitimacy in their eyes. As [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]] attempted to heal the [[Court]], the [[Silverlords|Silverlord]] questioned if she possessed their official word, and the members eventually turned their collective gaze upon [[Eithan]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Court]] of Seven scrutinizes the actions of Ozriel.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c6">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Court]] of Seven has restricted [[Eithan]]'s abilities.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Gadrael]] is the second member of the [[Court]] of Seven.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Court]] of Seven has not executed Ozriel.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Reaper Division]] seeks legitimacy in the eyes of the [[Court]] of Seven.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Abidan]] struck a blow on behalf of the [[Court]] of Seven.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Silverlords|Silverlord]] asks if she has the word of the [[Court]] of Seven.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Judge Suriel|Suriel]] has attempted to heal the [[Court]] of Seven.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Court]] of Seven stared at [[Eithan]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
